name: Four Seasons Danieli
insider_take: This legendary Venetian palace has been hosting royalty and dignitaries since 1822, occupying three historic buildings including a 14th-century Doge's palace right on the Grand Canal.
whats_special: The hotel's Dandolo Palace features original Gothic architecture with pink Verona marble facades, while the rooftop Restaurant Terrazza Danieli offers unparalleled 360-degree views of Venice's skyline. The property houses priceless Murano glass chandeliers and antique furnishings that have witnessed centuries of Venetian history.
pro_tip: Book a canal-view room on the piano nobile (second floor) for the most dramatic water vistas, and time your arrival by water taxi during golden hour to experience the palace's facade in all its glory.
dont_miss: The hotel's private dock provides exclusive Grand Canal access, while St. Mark's Square and the Doge's Palace are just a 2-minute stroll away. The Bridge of Sighs is visible from select suites, and the nearby Riva degli Schiavoni promenade offers some of Venice's most iconic photography opportunities.
pros: Historic 14th-century palace with authentic Venetian architecture
Prime location on Riva degli Schiavoni with stunning lagoon views
Luxury Four Seasons service and amenities in Venice's heart
Walking distance to St. Mark's Square and major attractions
cons: Historic building may have some space limitations
